text:
Marta: Quick one — hit a 404 from the routing doc. In /docs/platform/routing.md the 'redirects' link goes to /docs/networking/redirects which now 404s. Screenshot attached.

Marta: Exact URL: https://redwood.dev/docs/platform/routing#redirects -> 404. Looks like the target moved and the anchor changed.

Alex (docs): Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the link text or the snippet from the MD file? I can try to find the owner.

Marta: The line is: `[Redirect rules](/docs/networking/redirects#how-it-works)` — file probably should point to `/docs/platform/redirects-guide#how-it-works`.

Kevin: If it's just a broken relative link I can patch it in a tiny PR. Do we know who owns /docs/platform/routing.md?

DocBot: Link scan: /docs/platform/routing.md — owner: none (unassigned). Last content change 2024-10-11 by infra-bot.

Sara (triage): pinging docs owners — @miriam can you claim/triage?

Miriam: I can take this. I'll open a small PR: update the link to `/docs/platform/redirects-guide#how-it-works`, add a redirect entry to `redirects.yaml` for the old path, and fix the diagram alt text while I'm in the file.

Miriam: PR opened: #3489 — includes: link update, redirect rule, frontmatter `owners: platform` added to routing.md, alt text tweak, and a short changelog line. CI passed except a flaky image check which I re-ran.

Alex (docs): Nicely done. Two asks: 1) add a one-line note in /docs/contributing/link-policy.md about preferring canonical paths when moving pages, and 2) please add `owners: platform` so future pings go to the right team.

Miriam: Added both in the same PR. Also included tiny test to ensure old path returns 301 via the local dev server.

Kevin: I'll review the PR now. If it's small I can merge after one approval.

Marta: Awesome, thanks! Reminder to others: you can run `./scripts/check-links` locally or rely on the `link-scan` action that runs on PRs. :thumbsup:

Alex (docs): Recommendation: if you see a moved page, create a redirect entry first, then update links in place. Saves 404s during rollout. I'll add that as a short bullet in the link-policy doc.

Marta: Thanks all — closing this thread once merged.
